title: Atlas × Jev Phase-2.1 independent human label (one labeler, one record)
description: Schema for a SINGLE independent human judgment. One file per (record_id, labeler_id), stored as phase2/human_labels/<record_id>__<labeler_id>.json. Raw independent labels are never overwritten by adjudication; adjudicated labels live separately in phase2/human_labels_adjudicated/<record_id>.json. JEV signals/scores are NEVER valid human ground truth and must not appear in this file.

schema_version.description: Schema version pinned by phase2_1_labeling.py VALIDATOR.

record_id.description: Must exactly match a record_id in human_calibration_manifest.json.

arm.description: Must match the manifest arm for this record_id.

content_sha256.description: Must exactly match the manifest content_sha256 for this record_id (user_sha16:asst_sha16). Proves the labeler judged the exact byte-content the manifest references.

labeler_id.description: Stable anonymous ID for one independent labeler (e.g. labeler-a). Two DIFFERENT labeler_ids are required per record. Must match the __<labeler_id> filename suffix.

labeled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this judgment was recorded (e.g. 2026-09-18T10:00:00+00:00).

criteria_version.description: Labeling criteria version from the manifest. Labels under any other criteria version are rejected.

reference_version.description: Independent taxonomy reference version used for the category_correct judgment.

blinded_to_jev.description: Attestation that the labeler completed their pass WITHOUT seeing Jev signals/scores/flags for this record. Must be true.

correctness.description: Is the assistant response substantively correct given the user request? 'Substantively' = final answer/conclusion is right even with minor exposition flaws.

problematic.description: 'yes' = unsuitable as training data (contradictions, broken/garbled text, harmful content, prompt injection, PII leakage).

category_correct.description: 'yes' = content genuinely belongs to the record's category label, judged against taxonomy_reference_v1.json — NOT against the label's own plausibility.

notes.description: Optional free-text rationale (never a substitute for the three required labels).
